CMOS active-RC all-pass phase shifter
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VB vb 0 .9
VCM vcm 0 1.65
VIN vin 0 DC 1.65 AC 1
XDUT vdd 0 vb vin vcm out astra_085_cmos_active_rc_allpass
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec bias range 1.6 1.7 unit=V
* @spec glo range 0.85 1.1 unit=V/V
* @spec gmid range 0.85 1.1 unit=V/V
* @spec ghi range 0.85 1.1 unit=V/V
* @spec plo range -20 0 unit=degree
* @spec pmid range -105 -75 unit=degree
* @spec phi range -180 -150 unit=degree
.control
set filetype=ascii
dc VIN 1.65 1.651 .001
meas dc bias FIND v(out) AT=1.6505
ac dec 60 1k 1Meg
let gain=mag(v(out))
let phase=57.295779513*ph(v(out))
meas ac glo FIND gain AT=1k
meas ac gmid FIND gain AT=15.915k
meas ac ghi FIND gain AT=100k
meas ac plo FIND phase AT=1k
meas ac pmid FIND phase AT=15.915k
meas ac phi FIND phase AT=100k
write out.raw v(out)
quit
.endc
.end
